newsitem.title: USA: ComEd 789 MW Ill. nuke boosting power - NRC.
newsitem.headline: ComEd 789 MW Ill. nuke boosting power - NRC.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities nuclear power unit 1 was boosting power Thursday after cutting output over the weekend for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Cordova, Ill. unit was operating at 60 percent of capacity as of early Thursday and "increasing power," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit was reduced to about 50 percent of capacity over the weekend for repairs to a steam seal system.
The adjacent 789 MW Quad Cities nuclear unit 2 was operating at 100 percent of capacity early Thursday, the NRC said.
Commonwealth Edison is a unit of Unicom Corp.
